description: Land Acquisition - Thalgamuwa, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amendment to the Ex.Gaz.No. 1979/20 dated 10.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for acquisition. It contains notices under Section 7 of the Act regarding government acquisition of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
